preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through social engineering/compromise)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call adminAdd() to add attacker address as admin, then use admin privileges to manipulate the contract. Specifically: 1) Call adminAdd() with attacker address to gain admin role. 2) Use admin privileges to call initGame() to mint large amounts of tokens to attacker-controlled wallets. 3) Alternatively, use blackListAdd() to block other users, or adminRemove() to remove other admins. The owner has complete control over token minting, admin management, and blacklisting.
